enchantments.tooltip: Enhanced Jet Propulsion: Use this item to activate the air elemental bound within, thus propelling you forward at great speeds. It takes five minutes to recharge between uses.
Speed +30%: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 15% bonus to attack speed.
Insightful Mighty Skills Bonus: +10 Insight bonus to Jump and Swim.
Quality Mighty Skills Bonus: +5 Quality bonus to Jump and Swim.

Feather Falling: This item is engraved with feathers and bestows a powerful magical effect. Whenever the wearer begins to fall from any height, this effect slows the descent dramatically, causing the wearer to fall like a feather.
Mythic Boot Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
